key.name: show-track-name
key.description: Display track title next to the panel icon while media is playing

key.name: show-artist
key.description: Append the artist name to the track title shown in the panel

key.name: panel-label-width
key.description: Visible pixel width of the scrolling track label in the top panel. Changes apply immediately without a restart.

key.name: popup-width
key.description: Width of the popup media-player panel in pixels. Height scales proportionally with the album-art size.

key.name: hide-default-player
key.description: Hide the built-in GNOME Shell media player controls from the date/time menu. Fully restored when the extension is disabled.

key.name: player-filter-mode
key.description: 0 = off (allow all), 1 = blacklist (exclude listed), 2 = whitelist (only allow listed)

key.name: player-filter-list
key.description: Comma-separated list of MPRIS short names to include or exclude depending on the filter mode
